result_text:
Cancelled purchase orders are no longer counted in the per-rep purchase-order report. The full suite passes (605 tests).

- **Fix:** in `DataStore.findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` (`src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`, around line 6517), I added `AND po.status <> 'CANCELLED'`, the same filter the per-quarter and per-weekday queries already use.
- **Test:** added `src/test/java/com/acme/backoffice/SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest.java`. It sets up the Anna/Bob example from the task plus a rep with no purchase orders, and checks the result is `Anna:2`, `Bob:1`, `Cy:0`. It passes. I did not run it against the unfixed code to confirm it fails there.

Nothing is committed.
